name: Jane's Rivertown Restaurant
description: The premier dining experience at Dreamworld — Jane's Rivertown Restaurant is a relaxed full-service Australian restaurant serving generous meals including grilled steaks, chicken dishes, fish and chips and classic Australian pub-style food in a pleasant riverside atmosphere. The most popular sit-down dining option at Dreamworld Gold Coast.
